Period Drama 'The Revolutionaries' Set for September 2026 Release

Prime Video has announced that Nikkhil Advani's period drama, 'The Revolutionaries,' will premiere worldwide on September 11, 2026. The series focuses on four young revolutionaries who engaged in armed resistance against the British Empire during India's freedom struggle. The cast includes Bhuvan Bam and Rohit Saraf.
